scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: Last year, our designer Yunpin, he told me during a meeting, 'Boss, wait a second, I have something to tell you.' I said, 'What is it? Say it.' He said, 'Boss, I want to go abroad for two and a half months.'

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: Eh? Sounds a bit weird, right? You've been with the company for less than a year, and you want to go abroad for two and a half months. Suddenly I thought of something. When I was a salesperson before, I didn't dare to ask my supervisor for leave at all. So I felt envious in my heart and said, 'Fortunately, I'm your boss!'

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: I just said, 'Okay, go ahead. Do you have money?' He said, 'No, I'm traveling on a budget.'

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Hmm? Budget travel? I don't think that's right either. Well, let me think of a way for you. Why don't you go abroad and play, and I'll still pay you your salary as you work. At least you'll have money to live abroad.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: What I want to cultivate in you is the ability to work in various places.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: What I want to cultivate is your ability to work for a lifetime, not just your ability to work at our EinFit.

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.audio: So I let him take his laptop and go to South America.
